steps.title: Overlay risk gate: accept allowRiskyActions on POST /api/v1/browser-agent/run (patch 1 of 2)
steps.task: Accept an allowRiskyActions field (default false) from the request body on POST /api/v1/browser-agent/run, using PATCH MODE.
steps.spec:
Output in PATCH MODE ONLY: the OLD block below must be copied EXACTLY character-for-character from the real current file. NEW adds `allowRiskyActions = false` to the destructured req.body, with a short comment explaining it must be explicitly opted into. Exact text below, no other change.

OLD:
    const {
      goal,
      url = null,
      startUrl = null,
      site = null,
      vaultService = null,
      /** Inject login from tip process.env — e.g. WRM_WIX → WRM_WIX_EMAIL + WRM_WIX_PASSWORD (never echo values). */
      envCreds = null,
      mustContain = [],
      mustHaveSelector = [],
      expectSiteHost = null,
      expectAccountText = null,
      maxSteps = 20,
    } = req.body || {};

NEW:
    const {
      goal,
      url = null,
      startUrl = null,
      site = null,
      vaultService = null,
      /** Inject login from tip process.env — e.g. WRM_WIX → WRM_WIX_EMAIL + WRM_WIX_PASSWORD (never echo values). */
      envCreds = null,
      mustContain = [],
      mustHaveSelector = [],
      expectSiteHost = null,
      expectAccountText = null,
      maxSteps = 20,
      /** Explicit opt-in required for the overlay engine to click a real observed
       *  buy/purchase/pay/checkout/delete/cancel-labeled element. Default false. */
      allowRiskyActions = false,
    } = req.body || {};
non_goals: a full-file rewrite -- use patch mode only

steps.title: Overlay risk gate: pass allowRiskyActions into runGoalOnSession (patch 2 of 2)
steps.task: Pass allowRiskyActions through to the runGoalOnSession call in the /run handler, using PATCH MODE.
steps.spec:
Output in PATCH MODE ONLY: the OLD block below must be copied EXACTLY character-for-character from the real current file (this is the FIRST occurrence of this exact runGoalOnSession call -- the one inside the main goal-loop try block, NOT the wrm-wix-dns-cutover or signup handlers further down which have different call shapes). NEW adds `allowRiskyActions: allowRiskyActions === true,` right after `maxSteps: stepCap,`. Exact text below, no other change.

OLD:
      const result = await runGoalOnSession({
        session,
        goal: effectiveGoal,
        startUrl: targetUrl || startUrl,
        callModel,
        tiers: ['groq_llama', 'gemini_flash', 'cerebras_llama', 'openai_gpt', 'claude_sonnet'],
        mustContain,
        mustHaveSelector,
        expectSiteHost: host || expectSiteHost,
        expectAccountText,
        maxSteps: stepCap,
        onScreenshot: ({ step, screenshot }) => { if (screenshot) screenshots.push({ step, screenshot }); },
        logger,
      });

NEW:
      const result = await runGoalOnSession({
        session,
        goal: effectiveGoal,
        startUrl: targetUrl || startUrl,
        callModel,
        tiers: ['groq_llama', 'gemini_flash', 'cerebras_llama', 'openai_gpt', 'claude_sonnet'],
        mustContain,
        mustHaveSelector,
        expectSiteHost: host || expectSiteHost,
        expectAccountText,
        maxSteps: stepCap,
        allowRiskyActions: allowRiskyActions === true,
        onScreenshot: ({ step, screenshot }) => { if (screenshot) screenshots.push({ step, screenshot }); },
        logger,
      });
non_goals: a full-file rewrite -- use patch mode only
touching the wrm-wix-dns-cutover or signup handlers
